newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Minority stake in Brazil's Polibrasil goes on sale.
newsitem.headline: Minority stake in Brazil's Polibrasil goes on sale.

text.p: A minority stake in petrochemical firm Polibrasil is due to be sold at auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange today for a minimum price of 101 million reais ($101 million).
Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) is offering a 25.7 percent stake in Polibrasil that belongs to Petroquisa, a subsidiary of state oil giant Petrobras.
Ninety percent of the sale price can be paid in privatization bonds and the remaining 10 percent in cash.
The BNDES has estimated the total value of Polibrasil's share capital at 393 million reais ($393 million).

Petroquisa's stake in Polibrasil is expected to be bought by Polibrasil's other three shareholders, Polipropileno, Shell and Ipiranga that hold a 47.4 percent, 25.7 percent and 1.1 percent stake, respectively.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
